name: Star Trek
hook: Kirk, Spock, the Enterprise and the catchphrases — a franchise Jeopardy has asked about since 1966.

facts.label: Gene Roddenberry
facts.statement: Gene Roddenberry created Star Trek, which debuted in 1966; in 1992 a Space Shuttle crew carried his ashes into space.

facts.label: Spock
facts.statement: Leonard Nimoy played Spock; the Vulcan salute came from the Hebrew letter shin, and Vulcans mate in pon farr.

facts.label: James T. Kirk
facts.statement: William Shatner played James T. Kirk, appeared in all the original-cast films, and directed Star Trek V.

facts.label: Scotty
facts.statement: James Doohan played Scotty, lost a finger on D-Day, and devised the first version of the Klingon language.

facts.label: the Enterprise
facts.statement: Fans got the first Space Shuttle orbiter named Enterprise; a 14-foot model of the starship hangs in the Smithsonian.

facts.label: the Borg
facts.statement: The Borg warn "Resistance is futile"; they designated Jeri Ryan's Voyager character Seven of Nine.

facts.label: the spin-offs
facts.statement: Deep Space Nine and Voyager followed The Next Generation; Voyager ran from 1995 to 2001.
